exceptions.title: does not dismiss with the escape key that ends a composition spanning a reopen
exceptions.reason: The case asserts that Escape directly after `compositionend` keeps the popup open. Only WebKit sends `compositionend` before the `keydown` that ends a composition, so only WebKit needs that window. In the other engines Vase UI closes the popup (`BUG-6158`). The case "ignores Escape for 5 ms after compositionend in WebKit" tests the window in WebKit.

exceptions.title: prop getters are memoized
exceptions.reason: `setup` runs one time, so the composable makes the getters one time and their identity cannot change. React makes new getters when a props object of the list changes. A new case covers the half that applies: a getter reads the current props of an entry that changes.
